question: A is the husband of B, C is the mother-in-law of B, D is the father of A, E is the mother of D, F is the mother of C and G. If H is the father of D, then what is the relation of H with E?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cb384b16745d9961cf89502532460f1a891f149ce4076e89c58d73b5e18271e.png] 

Clearly, H is the husband of E.

Hence, ‘**Husband**’ is the correct answer.
